title: pellaea limitanea
intro: Pellaea limitanea, commonly known as the Mountain chain fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been used for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pellaea limitanea include its ability to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties which can be used to treat wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pellaea limitanea include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
